content.question: In Adam, what do the first moment and the second moment of the gradients represent?
options: First moment - a moving average of the gradients (as in Momentum); second moment - a moving average of the squared gradients (as in RMSProp).
First moment - a moving average of the squared gradients; second moment - a moving average of the gradients.
First moment - the Hessian; second moment - the gradient.
First moment - the learning rate; second moment - the batch size.
content.answer: First moment - a moving average of the gradients (as in Momentum); second moment - a moving average of the squared gradients (as in RMSProp).
